Topic 1.4: Compound Proportions and Rates of Work
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Compound Proportions and Rates of Work, part of Algebra 1.3 Indices and Logarithms (6 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand the in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use proportions in day to day activities? 2. Why do we work fast?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Compound Proportions and Rates of Work together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
10

• Citizenship- active community life skills: as learner works with peers to discuss and divide quantities into proportional

parts and express as a fraction.

• Critical thinking and problem solving- interpretation and inference; as learner works out rates of work.

Values:
• Responsibility; as learner commits to working out answers of given tasks on rates.

• Respect: as learner works out rates of work cooperatively.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-esteem: as learner devices personal strategies to estimate products in multiplication.

Link to other subjects:

Agriculture and nutrition helps learner estimate harvests, seeds or fertilizer required for sowing or application as part of rates

of work.
